factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for petrale sole.
factors.value_notes: DFO describes petrale sole as tolerating a wide range of bottom temperatures, but does not provide a species-specific preferred surface-temperature interval. The fish is demersal and the configured factor uses satellite SST; bottom-water tolerance cannot validate the 7-15 °C range or 9-13 °C ideal. Keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for petrale sole.
factors.value_notes: WDFW reports petrale sole on sand/mud bottoms from 18-550 m, most abundant at 55-128 m April-October and 274-457 m in winter. ODFW reports 10-300 fathoms with seasonal shifts from 30-70 fathoms in spring/summer to 150-250 fathoms in winter. This supports depth as important, but the configured 20-200 m range and 22-195 m ideal omit much of the winter spawning distribution.
